title: Bounded generators and the Fitting relation ideal under arbitrary pullback
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_W$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $r\geq0$. Assume that $E$ is locally generated by at most $r$ sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Put $\mathcal J=\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(E)$ if $r>0$, with Fitting ideal sheaf as in [def-trf-fitting-ideal-sheaf], and put $\mathcal J=0$ if $r=0$. Then $\mathcal J$ is quasi-coherent, and for every scheme $T$ and morphism $h:T\to W$, the ordinary pullback $h^*E$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] if and only if the image of $h^*\mathcal J\to\mathcal O_T$ is zero. More explicitly, when $r>0$ there is an affine open cover of $W$ by $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] on which $r$ sections generate $E$. Writing $M=E(U)$, these sections give a surjection $\pi:A^{\oplus r}\twoheadrightarrow M$ and $E|_U\cong\widetilde M$, with associated-sheaf notation of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. The ideal $\mathcal J(U)$ is generated by all coordinates of all elements of $\ker\pi$, independently of the generating surjection. For every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq T$ mapping into $U$, put $N=B\otimes_A M$. Then $(h^*E)|_V\cong\widetilde N$, there is a surjection $\pi_B:B^{\oplus r}\twoheadrightarrow N$, and the ideal generated by all coordinates of all elements of $\ker\pi_B$ is $\mathcal J(U)B=\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(N)$, the image ideal for $A\to B$ using [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. If $h^*E$ is locally free of rank $r$, this ideal vanishes on an affine refinement trivializing $h^*E$; if $\mathcal J(U)B=0$, the specified map $\pi_B$ is an isomorphism. When $r=0$, $E=0$ and both sides of the equivalence hold for every $h$. No Noetherianity, finite presentation or flatness hypothesis on $W,E,T,h$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 07ZD, lemma-fitting-ideal-finite-locally-free, proof by r generators and vanishing relation entries; sheaf and affine pullback form of divisors.tex Tag 0C3G, lemma-fitting-ideal-finite-locally-free; local tensor identifications as in Tag 0C3D.

proof.text: First suppose $r=0$. Being locally generated by the empty family means that every local section is locally zero, so the sheaf axiom gives $E=0$. The tensor construction of pullback gives $h^*0=0$, which is locally free of rank zero. The ideal $\mathcal J=0$ is quasi-coherent (locally it is the associated zero module), and its image in $\mathcal O_T$ is zero. This proves every assertion in this case. Henceforth $r>0$.

source.place: Tag 07ZD (lemma-fitting-ideal-finite-locally-free), rank-zero case; elementary zero-object argument

proof.text: Choose neighbourhoods with at most $r$ generating sections, pad each list by zero sections, and refine by affine opens $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$. Put $M=E(U)$. The counit in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction](3) gives $E|_U\cong\widetilde M$. The map $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}\to E|_U$ associated to the chosen sections is surjective as a sheaf map. Its source is quasi-coherent and has section module $A^r$ by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module]. Its sheaf image is therefore all of $E|_U$, and [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image](3) identifies its affine section image with its module image. Thus the specified map $\pi:A^r\to M$ is surjective.

The ideal $\mathcal J=\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(E)$ is quasi-coherent by [def-trf-fitting-ideal-sheaf]. Apply [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-sheaf-affine-sections] to $U,\pi$, with index $r-1$. Since the number of generators is $r$, its minors have size $r-(r-1)=1$. A matrix with one row in $\ker\pi$ has precisely the coordinates of that row as its minors. Hence $\mathcal J(U)$ is generated by all coordinates of all elements of $\ker\pi$. Part (1) of [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change] makes this ideal independent of the generating surjection.

source.place: Tag 0C3C (section-fitting-ideals), affine characterization; More on Algebra Tag 07Z8 (lemma-fitting-ideal)

proof.text: Fix any $h:T\to W$. Cover each $h^{-1}(U)$ by affine opens $V=\operatorname{Spec}B$. By [lem-trf-fitting-sheaf-arbitrary-pullback], with Fitting index $r-1$, we have $(h^*E)|_V\cong\widetilde N$ for $N=B\otimes_A M$, and the images $1\otimes m_i$ of the chosen generators generate $N$. They define the surjection $\pi_B:B^r\to N$. The same cited statement gives $\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(N)=\mathcal J(U)B$ without any flatness or finite-presentation assumption. The kernel-minor description in [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change], now over $B$ with $r$ generators, identifies this ideal with all coordinates of $\ker\pi_B$. Finally [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-sheaf-pullback] identifies the sheaf $\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(h^*E)$ with the image of $h^*\mathcal J\to\mathcal O_T$. Thus that image is zero exactly when these affine ideals are all zero.

Suppose the image ideal is zero. For each $U,V$ of step 4, every coordinate of every $z\in\ker\pi_B$ belongs to the zero ideal $\mathcal J(U)B$, and hence $z=0$. Thus $\pi_B$ is injective as well as surjective, so it is an isomorphism. Its inverse is linear: uniqueness of preimages gives additivity and scalar compatibility. Applying the associated-sheaf functor of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction](1) and [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module] gives $\widetilde N\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus r}$. These affine opens cover $T$, so $h^*E$ is locally free of rank $r$, and the specified map $\pi_B$ is an isomorphism on every such chart.

source.place: Tag 07ZD (lemma-fitting-ideal-finite-locally-free), last paragraph: vanishing of all relation entries; elementary application of the cited associated-sheaf functor

proof.text: Conversely, suppose $h^*E$ is locally free of rank $r$. Refine the affine cover of step 4 by affine opens $V^{\prime}=\operatorname{Spec}C$ on which it is trivial. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module], its section module is $C^r$. Present this module by the identity map $C^r\to C^r$, with zero kernel. Every size-one kernel minor is zero, and [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change](1) makes the same ideal zero for the generating surjection induced by the original $r$ sections. Applying step 4 on $V^{\prime}$ gives $\mathcal J(U)C=0$ and makes the image ideal sheaf zero there. A section of that image sheaf on any open restricts to zero on this cover, hence is zero by the sheaf axiom. The image ideal is therefore zero globally. This also proves the stated vanishing on an affine refinement trivializing $h^*E$.
